baseline_plan.title: Add power outlet using existing power strip
baseline_plan.summary: Use the available power strip to provide an extra socket for the small electrical device by connecting it to the wall outlet.

steps.action: Visually inspect power_strip_01 for any signs of damage, wear, or exposed conductors.
steps.why_it_helps: Ensures the power strip is physically safe before energizing.

steps.action: Insert the plug of power_strip_01 into the compatible wall power outlet, ensuring a firm connection.
steps.why_it_helps: Connects the power strip to the mains supply.

steps.action: Verify that the power strip's indicator (if present) shows it is energized or that the outlet is live by checking for any obvious signs of power (e.g., no sparks, smoke).
steps.why_it_helps: Confirms that the strip is receiving power without apparent faults.

steps.action: Plug the small electrical device's power cord into an available socket on power_strip_01.
steps.why_it_helps: Provides the additional power connection needed for the device.

steps.action: Monitor the device for normal operation; if any abnormal heating, noise, or smoke appears, immediately disconnect the device and power strip.
steps.why_it_helps: Detects any unsafe conditions early to prevent damage or hazard.

assumptions: The wall power outlet is functional and provides the correct voltage for the device.
The small electrical device's plug is compatible with the outlets on power_strip_01.
unresolved_risks: The electrical rating (maximum current/voltage) and internal condition of power_strip_01 are unknown; it may not safely handle the device's load.
If the device draws more current than the strip can safely supply, overheating or failure could occur.
constraint_check: No permanent modifications made; all connections are reversible.
Safety verification (visual inspection and energization check) performed before powered use.

zero_initial_plan.title: Add power outlet using power strip
zero_initial_plan.summary: Reposition the power strip, plug it into the wall outlet, then connect the small electrical device to the strip to gain an extra power connection.

steps.action: Move the power strip to a position near the wall power outlet.

capability_uses.purpose: move power strip to wall outlet

steps.why_it_helps: positions the strip for connection to the outlet

steps.action: Insert the power strip's plug into the wall power outlet to energize it.

capability_uses.purpose: supply power from wall outlet to strip

steps.why_it_helps: energizes the strip so it can deliver power

steps.action: Plug the small electrical device into one of the power strip's outlets.
steps.why_it_helps: gives the device an extra power source via the strip

unresolved_risks: Unknown electrical rating and condition of power strip may exceed safe load.
Potential exposure to moisture could cause shock or short circuit.
constraint_check: No permanent modification or damage to any item.
Safety verification of power strip's electrical rating and condition is preserved as unresolved risk.
